447985.d: 생명력이 80% 이상일 때 신성 충격의 치유량이 20%만큼 증가하지만 자신에게 치유량의 30%에 해당하는 치유 흡수 효과를 부여합니다. 이 효과는 사라질 때까지 빛의 봉화로 생명력을 회복하지 못하도록 방지합니다.

469886.d: 성공적으로 해로운 효과를 무효화하면 정화의 재사용 대기시간이 1.0초만큼 감소합니다. 신성한 무장을 사용하는 동안에는 효과가 100%만큼 증가합니다.

1241511.d:
응징의 격노의 재사용 대기시간이 30초만큼, 지속시간은 5.0초만큼 감소합니다.

응징의 성전사의 재사용 대기시간이 30.0초만큼, 지속시간은 3.0초만큼 감소합니다.

1241542.d: 오라 숙련 활성화 시 추가로 200%의 효율로 천상의 종을 시전합니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1241945.d: 잃은 생명력에 비례하여 받는 피해가 최대 10%만큼 감소합니다.

1242008.d: 응징의 격노 활성화 시 빛의 힘을 불러내 자신을 강화하여 다음 [응징의 성전사: 성스러운 빛 / 2회의 성스러운 빛]이 즉시 시전되고 마나 소모량은 50%만큼 감소합니다.

1245368.d:
8초마다 혹은 구세주의 봉화가 새로운 부상당한 대상에게 옮겨갈 때마다 대상에게 다음 0의 피해를 방지하는 피해 흡수 보호막이 부여되며, 15초 동안 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다.

구세주의 봉화가 추가로 자신의 성스러운 빛과 빛의 섬광 대상을 따라가며, 5초에 한 번씩 발동합니다. (5초 재사용 대기시간)

1: [광역 피해] Activate Avenging Wrath when the pack is gathered and Bloodlust goes out, and use Aura Mastery (3 min, Devotion Aura damage reduction raised to 12% for 8 sec) when Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (Holy 87284 every 2 sec for 6 sec, 60 yd) starts. On the Herald build, Ringing of the Heavens fires a Divine Toll with it.

[해제] If Thornblade bleeds (Physical 77586 every 2 sec for 12 sec) from the four Underbrush Stalkers stack on one DPS, remove them with Blessing of Protection (5 min) (Wowhead). Do not use it on the tank, because it drops their threat.
[참고] When Spore Spines slows from 13 Lashers stack on the tank, cast Blessing of Freedom (25 sec, immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec) on the tank.
2: [광역 피해] Aura Mastery was spent in pull 1, so answer Spouting Floret with Divine Toll (45 sec with Quickened Invocation) to put Holy Shock on 5 players. On the Virtue build, activate Beacon of Virtue (15 sec) first.

[차단] If the kick rotation misses Light Bolt Volley (party-wide Holy 174568) from the two Radiant Spellsowers, stun the caster with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 10 yd range). None of the four Mythic+ builds take Rebuke.
3: [탱버] If you spent Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) in pull 1, it may not be back yet. When Virid Grovekeeper starts the 2.5 sec Earthrupture Strike (Physical 533403) cast, top the tank off in advance with Holy Shock and Word of Glory (Eternal Flame on the Herald build).

[차단] If both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley together within 10 yd of the tank, stop both with Blinding Light (1 min 30 sec, 6 sec disorient). Lightgorged Lashers shielded by Lightbloom Pollination are immune to crowd control and will not be affected.
[참고] When Spore Spines slows from 12 Lashers stack on the tank again, cast Blessing of Freedom on the tank.
5: [광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first, so use Divine Toll on Spouting Floret, and when Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank for Earthrupture Strike.
[차단] If a Thorny Saptor uses Thornclaw Leap on you, stun it with Hammer of Justice to stop the follow-up cone attacks (Physical 145474) (Topicx).
7: [탱버] The Grievous Gash bleed from the two Luminous Thornmaws (Physical 48491 every 1 sec, stacking) only drops at full health. Raise the tank to 100% with Holy Shock and Word of Glory (Eternal Flame on the Herald build), and if stacks pile up and health falls, top them off at once with Lay on Hands (7 min with Unbreakable Spirit).
[해제] Blessing of Protection also removes the Grievous Gash bleed (Wowhead), but it drops the tank's threat, so do not use it in this pull.
10: [해제] Toxic Spew puts a poison (Nature 58189 every 1.5 sec for 9 sec) on the whole party. Cleanse (8 sec) frees only one player at a time, so dispel the lowest-health player first and carry the rest with Light of Dawn and Divine Toll.
[해제] On the Lightsmith build, Authoritative Rebuke reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1 sec (2 sec while wielding an armament) on each successful dispel, so keep pressing Cleanse during Toxic Spew.
11: [탱버] A tank still carrying the Grievous Gash bleed from Luminous Thornmaw also takes Spouting Floret Holy damage. Activate Aura Mastery during Floret and top the tank to 100% with Holy Shock first to clear the bleed.

[차단] If the kick rotation cannot stop Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient) from all three Lightfeather Petalwings, stop them together with Blinding Light once all three are within 10 yd of the tank.
12: [광역 피해] This is a big pull with six Lightgorged Lashers, Sporeblight Belcher, and two Radiant Spellsowers. Activate Avenging Wrath for Spouting Floret, and if a missed Light Bolt Volley lands, refill the party at once with Divine Toll.

[탱버] Lashers buffed by Pollen Surge (50% attack speed) from Lightbloom Pollination hit the tank fast, so keep Blessing of Sacrifice (30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on the tank until the shield breaks.

1: [해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (Nature 48491 every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% slower per tick) is a Magic effect, so Cleanse (8 sec) can remove it. If it spreads to several players, Cleanse the lowest-health player first and carry the rest with Light of Dawn.

[탱버] If Piercing Hiss (armor-ignoring Physical 135775, haste reduced by 30% for 6 sec) from the two Primal Serpents is missed, it stacks with the attack speed buildup of the seven Ravenous Descendants and the tank drops fast. Cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on the tank then.
2: [광역 피해] Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice (party-wide Physical 87284, then absorbs the next 162029 healing) is the most painful thing in this pull (Topicx). Activate Aura Mastery (3 min, Devotion Aura damage reduction raised to 12% for 8 sec) on the first Blood Sacrifice and use Divine Toll (45 sec with Quickened Invocation) to put Holy Shock on 5 players and burn the heal absorb. On the Herald build, Ringing of the Heavens fires a Divine Toll with Aura Mastery, so save your manual Divine Toll for the second Blood Sacrifice.

[탱버] When Dismember (3 sec cast, Physical 581895) starts, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank. Blessing of Protection also stops Physical damage, but it drops the tank's threat, so do not use it on the tank.
3: [광역 피해] Aura Mastery was spent in pull 2, so activate Avenging Wrath (2 min, 1 min 30 sec on the Call of the Righteous build) for this pull's Blood Sacrifice and burn the heal absorb with Light of Dawn. On the Virtue build, activate Beacon of Virtue (15 sec) first.

[차단] If the three Primal Serpents pulled around the pillar are within 10 yd of the tank and the kick rotation misses Piercing Hiss, stop them together with Blinding Light (1 min 30 sec, 6 sec disorient). None of the four Mythic+ builds take Rebuke.
5: [광역 피해] Paralyzing Shots dots from two Twinfang Harrowers overlap with Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice, which is hard to heal through in high keys (Topicx). If Aura Mastery is back, activate it for Blood Sacrifice, and line up Avenging Wrath with the window when Paralyzing Shots has spread to several players.

[해제] Remove Paralyzing Shots with Cleanse, starting with players who still carry the Blood Sacrifice heal absorb. On the Lightsmith build, Authoritative Rebuke reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1 sec (2 sec while wielding an armament) on each successful dispel, so keep pressing it.
7: [해제] High Evolutionist's Envenom poison (Nature 24246 every 1 sec for 8 sec) is dangerous when it overlaps with Rattling Writhe's Rattle (armor-ignoring Physical 58189 every 1 sec for 5 sec) (Topicx). When the 3 sec Rattle cast starts, Cleanse players carrying Envenom first.

[탱버] A tank hit by Corrosive Fangs (Nature 242456, damage taken increased by 20% for 20 sec) also takes more from Rattle. Cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank with the 3 sec Corrosive Fangs cast. It is Nature damage, so Blessing of Protection does not stop it.
8: [광역 피해] Line up Divine Toll with Rattle, and if the tank still has the Corrosive Fangs vulnerability when Rattle lands, focus Holy Shock and Word of Glory (Eternal Flame on the Herald build) on the tank.
9: [차단] If one of the two High Evolutionists starts Evolve (6 sec channel, gains a shield and crowd control immunity on completion) and the kick rotation misses it, stun the caster with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 10 yd range).

[광역 피해] If the Evolutionists are not dead before the second Mass Envenom, the whole party gets an 8 sec Nature dot. Save Divine Toll for this, and when it lands, put Holy Shock on 5 players and follow with Light of Dawn.
11: [차단] If the four High Evolutionists by the totem channel Evolve together within 10 yd of the tank, stop them all with Blinding Light; if only one channels, stop it with Hammer of Justice. An Evolutionist that finished Evolve is immune to crowd control and will not be affected.

[해제] With four Evolutionists, Envenom poison lands on several players at once. Cleanse (8 sec) frees only one player at a time, so dispel the lowest-health player first and carry the rest with Divine Toll and Light of Dawn.
12: [탱버] While the tank takes Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (Nature 67888 every 1 sec for 5 sec) pointed away from the party, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank. It is Nature damage, so Blessing of Protection does not stop it.

[광역 피해] When Infest (Nature 34914 every 1 sec for 5 sec, then a Nature 69827 burst within 8 yd) goes out, top players off with Divine Toll and Light of Dawn before the burst. If the fight reaches the third Infest, activate Aura Mastery.
13: [광역 피해] Activate Aura Mastery for Ula'tek's Chosen's Toxic Surge (party Nature 29095 every 1 sec for 9 sec), and save Divine Toll for when the six Living Venoms burst with Venom Burst.
[차단] If a Blade of the Altar teleports behind a player with Laced Edge during Toxic Surge, stun it with Hammer of Justice to pin it down (Topicx).
14: [광역 피해] Aura Mastery was spent in pull 13, so activate Avenging Wrath for this pull's Toxic Surge (Topicx uses party defensives on this Toxic Surge). On the Virtue build, apply Beacon of Virtue so players hit by Toxic Beam (Nature 339438) are healed along with the rest.
15: [해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots is a Magic effect, so remove it with Cleanse. Four Blades of the Altar add tank damage, so spend Cleanse on DPS first and support the tank with Holy Shock.
16: [광역 피해] Two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back and Ula'tek's Chosen's Toxic Surge overlaps, making this the heaviest healing pull in the dungeon (Topicx). Save both Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath for this pull: Aura Mastery on the first Blood Sacrifice, Avenging Wrath on Toxic Surge.

[탱버] Both Ritual Chieftains send Dismember at the tank. Take one with Blessing of Sacrifice, and if the other puts the tank in danger, refill them at once with Lay on Hands (7 min with Unbreakable Spirit).

1: [탱버] This pull takes Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together with Bloodlust (Topicx). Line up Avenging Wrath with Bloodlust, and when Shield Bash (Physical damage taken increased by 20% for 20 sec) lands on the tank, cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on them.

[해제] Heartstop Poison from the two Street Sneaks (Nature 193965 over 8 sec, max health reduced by 5% per stack) puts the tank in danger as stacks build (Topicx). Spend Cleanse (8 sec) on the tank first.

[해제] If Bribed Captain's Glaive Toss and Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleeds (Bleed 155172 over 8 sec) stack on one DPS or healer, remove them with Blessing of Protection (5 min) (Wowhead). Do not use it on the tank, because it drops their threat.
2: [해제] Seduction (6 sec disorient) from the two Seductive Sayaads is a Magic effect, so if a kick is missed and a player is caught, Cleanse it right away (Wowhead). If a Sayaad is within 10 yd of the tank, you can also stun it with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice) to stop the cast.
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks build fast (Topicx). Cleanse (8 sec) frees only one player at a time, so dispel the tank with the most stacks first and keep the tank's reduced max health full with Holy Shock. On the Lightsmith build, Authoritative Rebuke reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1 sec (2 sec while wielding an armament) on each successful dispel.
5: [해제] When a player asks for a dispel of Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle (Magic), Cleanse it right away (Topicx).
[광역 피해] While Massive Felwyrm is alive, Over-infused triggers Burning Fel (Fire 38793 within 50 yd) every 3 sec, so support the party with Divine Toll and Light of Dawn.
8: [광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher activates Demonic Frenzy below 50% (Fire 29095 every 1 sec until it dies), activate Aura Mastery (3 min, Devotion Aura damage reduction raised to 12% for 8 sec) and refill the party with Divine Toll. On the Herald build, Ringing of the Heavens fires a Divine Toll with it.
[해제] If Wrathguard Flayer's Flay bleed (Physical 38793 every 1 sec for 3 sec) stacks on a DPS, Blessing of Protection can remove it (Wowhead).
9: [참고] Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom is a Curse, which Holy Paladin cannot remove. After 10 sec, Shadow 581895 is split among players within 4 yd of the target, so top off the gathered players with Light of Dawn before it goes off.
[탱버] If the Drain Life target does not use a defensive, the Warlock heals a lot (Topicx). Cast Blessing of Sacrifice on a target who has no defensive.
10: [광역 피해] Aura Mastery was spent in pull 8, so activate Avenging Wrath (2 min, 1 min 30 sec on the Call of the Righteous build) for this Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy. On the Virtue build, activate Beacon of Virtue (15 sec) first.
11: [광역 피해] Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (party Fire 43642 every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) calls for splitting personal and party defensives (Topicx). Use Aura Mastery on the first Blade Dance and Divine Toll on the second, and if it reaches a third, activate Avenging Wrath.
13: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (party-wide Fire 145474) is where party defensives go (Topicx). If Aura Mastery is back, activate it for Slam; otherwise support with Avenging Wrath and Divine Toll.
[해제] If Flay bleeds from the two Wrathguard Flayers stack on one player, remove them with Blessing of Protection (Wowhead).
14: [탱버] When Shadow Bite (Shadow 38793 on each melee attack) from the two Trained Felhunters piles up on the tank, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank. It is Magic damage, so Blessing of Protection does not stop it.
15: [광역 피해] Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life and Curse of Doom overlapping with Shivan Punisher's sub-50% Demonic Frenzy is deadly (Topicx). Save Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath while the Warlock is killed separately, then activate both for the Punisher's Demonic Frenzy.
[탱버] If Shadow Bite from three Trained Felhunters and the Punisher's melee put the tank in danger, refill them at once with Lay on Hands (7 min with Unbreakable Spirit).
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem should die within two AoE casts with two party defensives assigned (Topicx). Activate Aura Mastery on the first Defiled Slam and Avenging Wrath on the second, and in between refill players hit by Defiled Detonation with Divine Toll.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust and cooldown pull (Topicx). Line up Avenging Wrath with Bloodlust, and activate Aura Mastery (3 min, Devotion Aura damage reduction raised to 12% for 8 sec) on Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery channel (party Shadow 38793 every 1 sec for 5 sec). On the Herald build, Ringing of the Heavens fires a Divine Toll with it.

[탱버] Mother's Wrath from the two Territorial Matriarchs is an Enrage, which Holy Paladin cannot remove. If no one can soothe, cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on the tank while an enraged Matriarch is hitting them.

[해제] If Razor Dive bleeds (Physical 33944 every 1 sec for 10 sec, stacking) from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack on one DPS or healer, remove them with Blessing of Protection (5 min) (Wowhead). Do not use it on the tank, because it drops their threat.
2: [참고] Spirit of Hunger's Insatiable Hunger curse (max health reduced by 15% for 25 sec, stacking) cannot be removed by Holy Paladin. A player at 2 stacks is in danger from a single Feast of Misery, so spend Holy Shock and Word of Glory (Eternal Flame on the Herald build) on them first.
[해제] Thornclaw Gatherer's Rotten Supplies is a Disease, so Cleanse (8 sec) can remove it.
4: [해제] If Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack on one player whose max health is also lowered by the Spirit of Hunger curse, remove the bleed with Blessing of Protection (Wowhead). If you used it in pull 1, its 5 min cooldown is not back yet, so top that player off with Holy Shock first.
7: [탱버] This is the cooldown pull after the boss, and with two Territorial Matriarchs the tank takes heavy Physical damage if no one can soothe (Topicx). When Matriarch Enrage stacks build, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank, and if the tank is in danger, refill them at once with Lay on Hands (7 min with Unbreakable Spirit).

[차단] If the kick rotation misses Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) from the two Earthwhisper Tenders, stun the caster with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 10 yd range). None of the four Mythic+ builds take Rebuke.
8: [탱버] Frostbite (Frost 67888) from the five Frostfangs only hits the tank, and Bloodrush raises their attack speed by 60%. Two Matriarchs join them, so tank damage is high (Topicx); cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank. Part of the damage is Frost, so Blessing of Protection cannot stop all of it.
[광역 피해] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward deals Nature 24246 to the whole party every 2 sec while the shield holds. Support the party with Divine Toll and Light of Dawn until the shield breaks.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Line up Avenging Wrath with Bloodlust, and use Divine Toll on cooldown while the Terra Rumbler shield is up.

[해제] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge is a Magic effect, so remove it with Cleanse. If it is not removed, the target has to move away from the party, so dispel Cryo Surge targets first, and free players hit by Frigid Roar (Haste and movement speed reduced by 50%) with Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead).
10: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx). If Aura Mastery is back, activate it when Cryo Surge from the two Glacial Revenants overlaps.

[해제] With two Glacial Revenants, Cryo Surge lands back to back. Cleanse (8 sec) frees only one player at a time, so dispel targets who must stay near the party, such as melee DPS, first. On the Lightsmith build, Authoritative Rebuke reduces Cleanse's cooldown by 1 sec (2 sec while wielding an armament) on each successful dispel.
11: [해제] Avatar of Determination's Glacial Tomb (Frost 38793 every 2 sec until destroyed) can be removed with Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead). When the party is encased, free one player first with Blessing of Freedom so they can break the others out.

[광역 피해] If melee players are hit by Pulverize (Physical 387930 within 12 yd, 4 sec stun), Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward damage stacks on top. Put Holy Shock on 5 players with Divine Toll to refill them at once.
13: [광역 피해] Primal Echo (armor-ignoring party Physical, stacking) from the two Grizzled Warbringers calls for defensives in high keys (Topicx). Activate Aura Mastery on the first Primal Echo and refill the party with Light of Dawn before the second Echo.
14: [광역 피해] This is a candidate for the third Bloodlust (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes out here, line up Avenging Wrath, and support the party with Divine Toll while the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (party Fire 36368 every 0.3 sec) are alive.
[차단] If Bonded Beasttamer enrages a Loyal Saberfang with Bestial Wrath and it chases a DPS or healer, stun the pet with Hammer of Justice. Holy Paladin cannot remove the Enrage.
15: [광역 피해] This is a big pull where four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so damage never stops (Topicx). Split Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath across different Echoes, and between Echoes refill the party with Divine Toll and Light of Dawn before the next one.
[탱버] If the tank holding four Warbringers also takes Primal Echo, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on them, and if they are still in danger, use Lay on Hands.
16: [광역 피해] In high keys Bloodlust goes out on Loa Speaker Nanea (Topicx), so line up Avenging Wrath, and activate Aura Mastery if Volatile Totem reaches its third wave.

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes the first corridor all the way to the Voidtouched Magi miniboss with Bloodlust (Topicx). Activate Avenging Wrath with Bloodlust, and if a Shadowbolt Volley (Shadow 193965 within 60 yd) is missed, put Holy Shock on 5 players with Divine Toll (45 sec with Quickened Invocation) to refill them at once.

[해제] When Feral Saberon's Savage Leap bleed (Physical 38793 every 1 sec for 5 sec) stacks on the tank, high keys need an external defensive (Topicx). Cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min, 30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on the tank, and if it stacks on a DPS or healer, remove the bleed with Blessing of Protection (5 min).
2: [광역 피해] Raj'kess the Spellstorm's long party-wide Thundering Storm calls for defensives and healing cooldowns (Topicx). Activate Aura Mastery (3 min, Devotion Aura damage reduction raised to 12% for 8 sec) as the cast finishes and follow with Light of Dawn. On the Herald build, Ringing of the Heavens fires a Divine Toll with it.

[참고] If even one Orb of Disruption cast finishes, the whole party loses a lot of Haste and heals cast slowly (Topicx). Then carry the party with instant Holy Shock and Word of Glory (Eternal Flame on the Herald build) instead of Holy Light.
3: [광역 피해] Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (party Nature 87284 every 2 sec for 10 sec) calls for healing cooldowns in high keys (Topicx). Aura Mastery was spent in pull 2, so line up Avenging Wrath (2 min, 1 min 30 sec on the Call of the Righteous build) and Divine Toll, and on the Virtue build activate Beacon of Virtue (15 sec) first.

[해제] Melt Armor from the five Sycophantic Tarasek (Fire damage taken increased by 10% for 10 sec) is a Magic effect, so Cleanse (8 sec) can remove it, but it does little damage (Topicx). Use Cleanse on the tank when there is nothing else to dispel.

[참고] If a melee DPS hit by Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (party Nature 155172, movement speed reduced by 40% for 12 sec) needs to dodge Brutok's Smashing Charge, cast Blessing of Freedom (25 sec) on them.
5: [광역 피해] Before Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike (5 sec cast, Nature 872842 within 10 yd shared among players hit), top the party off with Holy Shock and Light of Dawn, and refill them right away with Divine Toll when they land after the knock-up.

[차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area (Topicx). If the kick rotation misses it, stun the caster with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 10 yd range). None of the four Mythic+ builds take Rebuke.
6: [광역 피해] If Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams (party Physical 48491 every 1.5 sec for 30 sec, 10% stronger per slam) overlaps with the Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak, it wipes high keys (Topicx). If the shield breaks late and stacks build, activate Aura Mastery, and refill the party with Divine Toll right before Sky Strike.

[탱버] If the target of Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (Shadow 43642 within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec) has no defensive in a high key, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on them (Topicx has the target use a defensive).
8: [광역 피해] Devouring Brutalizer's Dreadbellow (party knockback, Shadow 29095 every 1 sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled) calls for party defensives (Topicx). Activate Aura Mastery on Dreadbellow and refill the party with Divine Toll after the knockback.

[탱버] Brutalize (Physical 678877 every 1.5 sec for 6 sec) always follows Dreadbellow (Topicx). When the 4.5 sec Dreadbellow cast appears, have Blessing of Sacrifice ready and cast it on the tank as the Brutalize channel starts.
9: [탱버] If the Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) used in pull 8 is not back, focus Holy Shock and Word of Glory on the tank for the second Devouring Brutalizer's Brutalize, and if the tank is in danger, refill them at once with Lay on Hands (7 min with Unbreakable Spirit).

6: [광역 피해] Below 50%, Flamegullet stacks Molten Blood (Fire 48491 within 60 yd every 3 sec, 15% stronger per cast), and in keys 17 and above Bloodlust goes out at Flamegullet 50% (Topicx).
